name: cursor-cloud-control
description: A typed, safety-first control plane for Cursor Cloud Agents API v1.

interface.longDescription: Use a typed MCP control plane for Cursor Cloud Agents API v1: discover resources, create and follow up runs, stream bounded progress, inspect usage and artifacts, cancel runs, and archive or delete agents with explicit safety barriers.
defaultPrompt: Create a plan-mode Cursor Cloud Agent with safe defaults.
Monitor a Cursor run through bounded SSE or polling.
